title: Tunare
summary: Engage Tunare's ground form while controlling the forest response.
overview: Engaging the Tunare in the tree replaces her with the ground encounter. The active content flag selects either normal Tunare or the Fabled Tunare.
Normal Tunare adds the attacker to the hate lists of nearly all non-pet NPCs in the zone, with a small explicit exception list. Clear or prepare for the forest before beginning the fight.

abilities.name: Forest assistance
abilities.summary: Tunare calls the surrounding forest into the battle.
description: Normal Tunare calls the zone on combat entry. Fabled Tunare instead moves a defined list of NPC types toward her and repeats that call every six minutes while engaged.

sections.title: Fabled variant
paragraphs: The fabled_velious content flag selects the fabled ground form. Both variants are represented by this zone-version-0 entry because the script uses a content flag rather than a different zone version.

notes: Approved row E138. Quest source reviewed; live encounter behavior and loaded database spell/loot data have not been verified.
Normal Tunare starts a timer named despawn but handles depop; the intended 20-minute return/reset is not implemented consistently.
The Fabled helper accesses listed NPCs without checking that each exists. Verify live population and assistance behavior before publication.
